description: Before your agent pays an XRPL address: one verdict (block / caution / proceed) by fixed published rules — the destination's XRPLScore, a sanctions screen against every list XRPLHub holds (with a verifiable receipt), account age and ledger flags, and whether the ledger would REJECT the payment (missing destination tag, Deposit Authorization, no RLUSD trust line, unfunded account). This is a PAID x402 call: $0.03 in USDC on Base or RLUSD on the XRP Ledger at GET /api/x402/precheck. This tool returns the payment resource to call; it does not run the check. Params: destination (r..., required), amount, currency (XRP|RLUSD), destination_tag, from (your paying address).

amount.description: Optional: the amount you intend to send (plain decimal)

currency.description: Optional: XRP (default when amount is given) or RLUSD

destination.description: The XRPL address (r...) you are about to pay

destination_tag.description: Optional: the destination tag you will use

from.description: Optional: your paying address — lets the check test Deposit Authorization preauth

name: precheck_payment
